message.content: **What I did and why:** I reviewed the saved notes (long-term holder, dividends reinvested manually) and the account (no AAPL position, 20 INTC shares, $50,000 cash), then checked the live quote for AAPL at $222.70 last / $222.72 ask. With no position in AAPL and a mandate that permits only buys in AAPL and INTC, I placed a single buy limit order for 22 shares at $222.72 — the current ask, so the limit is at market rather than away from it — for a notional of about $4,900, which stays under the $5,000 per-order cap and well under the $10,000 daily total, and requires no money movement out of the account. The order filled at $222.72. My decision to add AAPL was supported by the figures the company reported in its FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-11-01): revenue of $391,035 million, net income of $93,736 million, and diluted EPS of $6.08 — i.e., roughly $222.72 per share is about 36.6× trailing earnings for a business still generating very large absolute profit, which is consistent with a long-term holding rather than a trade. I did not touch INTC, and I made no sales or transfers.
